name: Farmer-first homepage, five navigation areas and Tamil toggle
description: Verifies a rural farmer can understand the core benefits immediately and reach a practical first workflow on a phone.
steps: Open app at 375px width
Read the opening message and three farmer benefit labels
Select Start with my farm and confirm Farm profiles opens
Return to Overview and open Explore village demo
Switch Tamil and English
Inspect the five primary navigation areas
expected: The homepage explains crop comparison, irrigation planning and Tamil guidance; the farm profile and clearly labelled demo entry points work; Tamil/English toggle and mobile navigation remain usable.

name: OpenRouter credential and contextual AI workflow
description: Checks the backend validates the configured credential and a contextual question receives a grounded explanation.
steps: Open Evidence & AI
Wait for AI connection status
Ask: With a 40% supply shock, what should our village review first?
Inspect the answer and model route
expected: The UI reports connected only when OpenRouter accepts the server-side key; a grounded response appears; no key value is returned to the browser.

name: Weather, village scenario and adaptive intervention search
description: Checks weather provenance, deterministic scenario changes and transparent optimizer output.
steps: Open Water outlook and inspect source/timestamp
Open Resilience Engine and select a 40% supply shock
Inspect the three ranked intervention alternatives
Select an alternative and inspect farm-level screening rows
Review the uncertainty sensitivity range and its disclaimer
expected: Scenario values recalculate; up to three candidate strategies and farm-level screening rows appear; sensitivity is labelled as a range rather than a statistical confidence interval.

name: Pump-Minute and WaterProof core workflows
description: Checks the action and evidence workflows remain available inside the simplified navigation.
steps: Open Irrigation then Pump-Minute
Set pump flow to 10 L/min, 30 minutes and 100 L storage; calculate plan
Open Evidence & AI then WaterProof
Record a baseline with an evidence note
expected: Pump delivery respects the storage limit and shows unmet target; WaterProof records server-validated hash integrity while retaining farmer-reported verification status.

name: Mobile layout and external-provider fallback
description: Checks phone usability and useful fallback behaviour when external providers are unavailable.
steps: Open at 375px width
Navigate through all five primary areas
Open the optimizer and select a strategy
Simulate an unavailable AI or weather provider
Open Pump-Minute
expected: Navigation and optimizer remain usable on mobile; provider failures show understandable feedback and deterministic planning remains available.
